raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Selecting `--speculative-draft-attention-backend cutedsl_mla` uses CuTeDSL MLA for draft decode, but the draft-prefill/extend factory still constructs `TRTLLMMLABackend` and identifies it as `trtllm_mla`. The existing `CuteDslMLABackend` already inherits prefill/extend support, so this fallback prevents the requested backend from serving draft extend.

## Modifications

- Construct `CuteDslMLABackend(skip_prefill=False)` for draft prefill/extend, assert that the draft model uses MLA, and preserve the `cutedsl_mla` backend identity through the wrapper.
- Register `cutedsl_mla` with the existing TRTLLM MLA model-dispatch handler. Ordinary prefill selects `MHA_CHUNKED_KV` with unabsorbed head dimensions; decode and speculative draft extend select MLA.
- Extend the existing CPU regression suite to exercise the real factory with a mocked backend constructor, wrapper identity, rejection of non-MLA models, and model dispatch.

This reuses FlashInfer's `backend="cute-dsl"` path and existing prefill plumbing. No kernel implementation or backend defaults change.

## Accuracy Tests

The backend-decision suite passes: **11 tests and 3 subtests**.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest test/registered/unit/test_split_attention_backend_decisions.py -q -x -o addopts=''
```

These are CPU dispatch and factory tests. GPU end-to-end accuracy has not been tested for this isolated change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Isolated Pulse results are mixed and incomplete; no broad throughput benefit is established.** Batch 1 improved by 2.4% and 3.3% in two pairs. Other completed points were small or inconsistent: batch 2 changed from +6.1% to −2.2%, and batch 4–64 stayed within −2.8% to +1.1%. Keeping this PR as a draft.

Kimi 2.6 INT4, four GB300 GPUs per server (TP4/DP1), BF16 KV, an 8k ShareGPT context bucket, and a selected rank-32 zero LoRA adapter. Both revisions request `cutedsl_mla` for draft attention; the baseline falls back to TRTLLM MLA for draft extend, and the candidate adds only this factory/dispatch integration and its tests. Target prefill remains fa4 and target decode trtllm_mla. EAGLE3 uses three draft steps and four draft tokens. Requested output is 512 tokens, with a 256-token decode measurement window, temperature 1.0, and top_p 0.95. Seeds below control prompt selection; no per-request sampling seed was supplied.

| Batch | Seed 0: baseline → candidate out tok/s | Δ | Seed 8: baseline → candidate out tok/s | Δ |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 212.0 → 217.0 | +2.4% | 211.5 → 218.5 | +3.3% |
| 2 | 346.6 → 367.9 | +6.1% | 354.0 → 346.2 | -2.2% |
| 4 | 554.4 → 546.7 | -1.4% | 559.2 → 543.6 | -2.8% |
| 8 | 793.9 → 786.6 | -0.9% | 830.6 → 840.0 | +1.1% |
| 16 | 1,218.2 → 1,217.9 | -0.0% | 1,235.6 → 1,241.6 | +0.5% |
| 32 | 1,761.8 → 1,779.7 | +1.0% | 1,733.3 → 1,773.5 † | +2.3% |
| 64 | 2,350.1 → 2,365.4 | +0.6% | — | — |
| 128 | 3,222.5 → 3,204.9 ‡ | -0.5% | — | — |

† Seed 8 batch 32: one of three repetitions completed. ‡ Seed 0 batch 128: two of three repetitions completed. These incomplete points are not full Pulse results. All other displayed points completed their configured repetitions: eight at batch 1, four at batch 2, three elsewhere.

The seed-0 pair failed before generation for batch 128 repetition 3 because Kimi’s renderer rejected an empty model message in ShareGPT. Seed 8 passed CPU validation of the warmup, measurement, and possible profiling prompts. That pair was stopped during batch 32 while discussing whether to close the PRs; the later decision was to leave them as drafts. The stopped runs were not resumed.

All completed points had zero request failures and retractions. Neither pair finished a full curve: the JSONLs are empty and no corresponding Spanner rows were persisted, so the table is reconstructed from controller logs. Prefill throughput, tail latency, and profile traces were not saved. These are single-batch downstream monorepo measurements on different physical nodes, not a benchmark of the upstream PR head. The zero adapter exercises LoRA execution but is not a trained-adapter quality test. No GPU accuracy, identical-output, batch-invariance, or KL0 claim is made.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with the repository's pre-commit hooks.
- [x] Add unit coverage in the existing registered CPU suite.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.
- [ ] Provide GPU accuracy and speed results before promoting this draft for review.
